Name: Joel, Son of Jehiel
Summary: Brother of Zetham, over the treasures of the house of the LORD.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:22: Brother of Zetham, over the treasures of the house of the LORD.
LifeLesson: The mention of Joel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
